shortDescription: According to CNBC, India’s largest digital and telecom operator, Jio Platforms, received regulatory approval for an initial public offering. The National Stock Exchange, which is also pursuing a large share sale, is still waiting for regulatory clearance.

title: Jio Platforms Gets Regulatory Nod for IPO as National Stock Exchange Awaits Clearance
